description: I am always available to answer all your questions. Schedule a consultation — I'd love to help you optimise your business!

faq.question: Do you help with domain and hosting?
faq.answer: Yes, I fully support you in selecting and registering a suitable domain and setting up reliable hosting for your website. I choose the optimal domain according to your brand and target audience and recommend hosting solutions that guarantee fast loading times, high security and stable performance. You receive a finished website connected to your domain and set up on the server — with no technical effort on your part.

faq.question: Can I order a multilingual website?
faq.answer: Yes, I develop websites with full multilingual support. If your target audience speaks multiple languages — for example Ukrainian, English or Polish — I integrate a user-friendly language switcher optimised for both users and search engines. Each language version gets its own SEO settings, improving your website's visibility on Google in different regions.

faq.question: What technologies do you use?
faq.answer: I use a modern technology stack that offers high performance, security and scalability. I use HTML5, CSS3 and JavaScript for a responsive frontend, React for the user interface and Next.js for SEO and server-side rendering. For backend development I use Node.js and MongoDB for data processing. I also work with Git and design tools like Figma or Adobe XD.

faq.question: How do you test the website before launch?
faq.answer: Before launch the website is thoroughly tested. I check responsiveness on various devices, the functionality of all elements, display in different browsers, loading speed and carry out a technical SEO check. The website is deployed on a test server to be comprehensively tested under real-world conditions.
